svg.title: Nishemani Corsair - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: High Guard Update 2022, printed 195-198, PDF 196-199. Both deck plans agree on pointed polygonal forward body, long narrow neck and broad swept stepped aft hull. Shared grid and matching profiles support alignment. Illustration corroborates narrow connection and wide aft body. Docking bay is enclosed interior space in the top projection, not a hole; no carried ship drawn. Adjustable disguise modes are not represented; this is published baseline configuration.
